commands.review_summary:
The PR caps command `before_reset` transcript reads at 16 MiB with `readRegularFile` and updates reset-hook tests for oversized and archived transcript handling.

PR surface: Source +39, Tests +45. Total +84 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main and `v2026.6.11` read primary and archived reset-hook transcripts with uncapped `fs.readFile`, so an oversized JSONL can be buffered. I did not run an actual OOM reproduction in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A maintainer should decide the plugin-visible hook payload contract before repair or merge; the branch also still needs proof of the actual reset-hook path.

target.title: fix(commands): bound reset-hook transcript reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`loadBeforeResetTranscript` in `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-reset-hooks.ts` reads session transcript JSONL files with unbounded `fs.promises.readFile` calls. A runaway or corrupted transcript file could force the `before_reset` hook path to buffer the entire file into memory, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reset-hook transcripts are line-oriented JSONL files. A 16 MiB cap is generous headroom for long sessions while preventing the reset hook path from being used as a memory exhaustion vector. When the cap is exceeded, the hook fires with empty messages, matching the existing fallback behavior for unreadable files.

## User Impact

`before_reset` hooks now safely skip oversized transcripts instead of risking process OOM.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test that writes a transcript exceeding the 16 MiB cap, mocks a `before_reset` hook runner, and asserts the hook fires with empty messages.
- Local focused run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/commands-reset-hooks.test.ts --run` passes (13/13 tests).


## Real behavior proof

I ran a standalone Node script that imports the same bounded reader used by the reset-hook path (`readRegularFile` from `src/infra/regular-file.ts`) with the same 16 MiB cap. It exercises both a normal transcript and an oversized transcript:

```text
$ node --import tsx /tmp/proof-101479.mjs
PR #101479 real behavior proof: reset-hook transcript bounded read
Max bytes: 16777216
Normal file size: 122
Oversized file size: 16777217

--- Normal transcript ---
Result: loaded 2 message(s)
Messages: [{"role":"user","text":"hello"},{"role":"assistant","text":"hi"}]

--- Oversized transcript ---
Result: rejected before parsing, hook would fire with empty messages
```

The normal transcript loads and parses into messages as expected. The oversized transcript (16 MiB + 1 byte) is rejected by `readRegularFile` before any JSONL parsing or downstream hook processing, so `loadBeforeResetTranscript` returns empty messages and the `before_reset` hook fires safely without buffering the runaway file.
